subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The mangroves were not neat like a sea wall, but they were alive and flexible.”?
options: What seems normal on one plate may look surprising on another, but each meal has a reason.
Nature-based protection may look messy, but it can work with forces that hard structures only resist.
A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.
Saving water was serious work, but the song made the message simple enough for everyone to carry.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「What seems normal on one plate may look surprising on another, but each meal has a reason.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The mangroves were not neat like a sea wall, but they were alive and flexible. Nature-based protection may look messy, but it can work…」，答案為「Nature-based protection may look messy, but it can work with forces that hard structures only resist.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Nature-based protection may look messy, but it can work with forces that hard structures only resist.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
